Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, active deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and the active source is exactly f487e6d8fc1dcb6654a7b06bda0bb30807d292c0 or a later verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main commit. Any identity mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof or target drift blocks fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, and Bureau runtime identity is integrity-valid at that exact target.

The authority is consumed at most once after successful immutable readback and grants only Bureau runtime/Registry convergence. Any later follow-up must use its own separate normal reviewed TaskSpec path. This authority grants no Heim-PC NixOS installation or cutover effect, storage/EFI mutation, reboot, queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, secret handling, follow-up implementation, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.
